table_h.label: Pipeline A
table_h.description: NLTK tokens, NLTK stop words, Porter stemming (the brief's left branch)

table_h.label: Pipeline B
table_h.description: spaCy tokens, no stop-word removal, WordNet lemmas with POS (the brief's right branch)

table_h.label: H: hybrid hypothesis
table_h.description: Hybrid tokens, POS-aware spaCy lemmas from the cased linguistic branch, custom stop list on lemma forms

table_h.label: C1 order test
table_h.description: As A, but stem BEFORE stop-word removal (Exercise 9)

table_h.label: C2 no-POS lemma
table_h.description: As B, but WordNet lemmas WITHOUT POS tags (shows the POS -> lemma dependency)

table_h.label: C3 BPE index
table_h.description: tiktoken cl100k_base subword pieces as index terms, no stop words, no normalisation

table_h.label: H2: hybrid, revised (post-hoc)
table_h.description: As H, but context-free lemmas on the index branch (queries have no sentence context) and hyphenated compounds also indexed by their parts. Designed AFTER error analysis of H on the same 15 queries, so its scores are optimistic and it is not eligible for selection.

queries.information_need: Documents that explain, practise or show learners reasoning explicitly about denominators.
Documents that identify, describe or study students' misconceptions (systematic misunderstandings).
Documents that explain or apply finding and using a common denominator.
Documents describing knowledge tracing models (estimating or predicting student knowledge over time).
Documents where adding numerators (with or without adding denominators) is described, as the correct procedure or as the add-across error.
Documents about misconceptions specifically concerning fractions.
Documents that explain or use the least common denominator.
Documents about denominators in contexts OTHER than finding a common denominator (meaning of the denominator, multiplying and dividing, decimals and percents as fractions).
Documents that contain or study tutoring or classroom dialogue between teachers or tutors and students.
Knowledge tracing research outside programming education.
Documents that teach, practise or discuss decimals or percents.
Documents that contain students' explanations of their reasoning, or study such explanations.
Documents that use the number line to represent or compare fractions or decimals.
Documents about students' misconceptions about fractions.
Documents on using large language models for knowledge tracing.

selection_rule: highest mean F1, then P@5, then domain-term fidelity, then the smaller vocabulary
